integrity: An all-parameter signed recurrence proof and exact seven-step matrix identity are supplied with a standalone independent brute-force Walsh checker. Literature priority remains bounded by accessible sources; no independent expert validation has been performed.
limitations: Exact invertibility classification on binary vertex cubes of labelled open paths only; full singular nullity, optimal nonzero gaps, and extensions to cycles are not claimed.
title: A seven-period invertibility criterion for maximal-independent-set convolution on paths
